title: Exchange Online Quarantine Summary
summary: Read-only Exchange Online script for quarantine summary.
description: Official OperatorOS ScriptForge seed script that collects quarantine summary data for technician review, reporting, and customer documentation. This script is designed as a read-only audit/reporting baseline.
use_case: Use this script when building a Exchange Online health report, onboarding baseline, recurring audit, or escalation packet.

safety.notes: Official OperatorOS read-only audit/reporting seed script. Review tenant scope and permissions before running.

requirements.name: Exchange Online PowerShell module with read-only recipient and organization permissions.

examples.title: Run report
examples.description: Runs the read-only audit report with default options.

output.description: PowerShell object output suitable for pipeline export, transcript capture, or manual review.

script_body:
# OperatorOS ScriptForge official read-only audit script
# Category: Exchange Online
# Report: Quarantine Summary

$ErrorActionPreference = 'Stop'

Get-QuarantineMessage -PageSize 100 | Select-Object ReceivedTime,SenderAddress,Subject,Type
